title: Real-valued formula for the parity-based function
statement: For every positive integer $m$, the real-valued version of the function obtained by taking the AND of the parities on the first and last $2m$ coordinates is, at each input $x\in\{\!-1,1\!\}^{3m}$, equal to one half of $1$ plus the monomial on the first coordinate set plus the monomial on the last coordinate set minus the monomial on their symmetric difference.
